gmReview.notes: We got all the pieces, but over multiple rounds of editing, we ended up with significant noise and artifacts. Regenerate the image fresh. In fact, give me 2-3 different variants based on this concept.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a FRESH full-body bestiary portrait from this written concept, not an edit of previous artwork. One colossal bear, about three metres at the shoulder and five metres from nose to its SHORT bear tail, standing naturally on FOUR plantigrade paws. Anatomically a BEAR with a recognisable bear head, shoulder hump and heavy paws; no cat features. Its body is mostly HAIRLESS: bare shoulders, chest, neck, belly, flanks and upper limbs. Fur is restricted to the face/muzzle, a narrow strip along the spine, short tail and lower legs/paw cuffs. The bare body is lean beneath loose draping skin, with a few LARGE soft hanging folds at neck, belly and limb joints. Many old healed scars, around 12–18 broad closed pale scar bands of varied length across exposed shoulders/flanks/upper limbs; no open wounds or blood. 
Rendering is naturalistic HAND-PAINTED game illustration with restrained brushwork. Broad skin planes have visibly SMOOTH, uninterrupted light-to-shadow gradients and calm colour fields between the large folds/scars. Anatomy is described through large value masses, not tiny surface lines. Fur is grouped into soft simple masses with selected silhouette tufts. Detail concentrates at eyes, nose, claws and a few scar edges. Soft diffuse upper-left light. Empty dark charcoal painted backdrop, only faint contact shading. Portrait aspect about 4:5, the ENTIRE animal including all four feet and tail comfortably inside margins. No text, labels, border, props or clothing. No uniform fine web of skin lines, dense pores or photographic texture noise.
Variant A: a broad-boned old brown bear with a high structural shoulder hump, narrowed sunken waist and lean bare upper arms, warm muted taupe skin and dark chestnut face/spinal/paw fur. Three-quarter front view from its chest height, head lowered slightly toward the viewer, all four weight-bearing paws separated. Heavy loose throat and belly folds, an alert stern expression, pale broad scars most visible on the near shoulder and flank. Keep the broad frame without inflated muscular arms or fat spherical torso.
